text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 502/504 error rate observed at api-gateway-edge in us-west-2. 10m error rate = 18% (baseline 0.4%). Paging oncall.
alex: I'm on it — pulled up the dashboard. Spikes start ~2105012280, correlates with increased SYN backlog on front-line proxies.
meera: seeing a lot of 'upstream timed out' in edge-proxy logs. Example:
```
[2026-03-14T18:12:30Z] proxy=nginx client=10.2.1.5 request="POST /v1/generate" upstream_timeout
```
sam: are we adding new routes or deployments around that time? I don't see any deploys in the last hour.
lee: no deploys. Autoscaler shows CPU on proxy nodes jumped 3x, but origin app pods are healthy.
oncall: @alex can you confirm if LB health checks started failing or if backend connections exhausted?
alex: health checks mostly green. But TCP backlog on the proxy side is high; kernel stats show many TIME_WAIT and accept queue growth. suspect connection exhaustion to origin NLB.
eng-sre: hypothesize: sudden client bursts + keepalive misconfig causing proxy connection pool to starve. Trying immediate mitigation: reduce keepalive_timeout on proxy and enable connection reuse.
meera: rolling a targeted config change to edge-proxy pool (nginx conf) on 2 nodes to test. Command:
```
kubectl set env deploy/edge-proxy KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT=15 -n infra
```
sam: meanwhile, can we enable short-term rate limit at edge for high QPS keys? I can patch a route rule to 200r/s for /v1/generate from unknown clients.
lee: applying rate limit now. patch:
```
PATCH /config/routes
{ "/v1/generate": { "rate_limit": 200 } }
```
alex: after config change on nodes 1/2, error rate dropped from 18% -> 9% in ~45s. Good signal.
oncall: great -- do we need to scale proxies or adjust NLB connection settings as permanent fix?
eng-sre: I'm launching a conservative horizontal scale for edge-proxy pool (+40%) and enabling connection keepalive pool tuning on NLB targets. Sam, can you coordinate infra change request?
sam: filed infra ticket INF-4532 and started scale-up. ETA for additional pods ~2m.
meera: logs show upstream 504s reduced significantly. We'll keep the rate limit while we observe for 10m. If stable, roll a full cluster config update with keepalive settings.
alex: customer impact: a handful of high-QPS customers saw increased errors (estimated 0.6% of requests failed end-to-end during peak). CS alerted and we added note to status page draft.
lee: posting a short status update: "Investigating elevated API errors; mitigation in progress. Limited impact to small subset of clients."
oncall: handing off to night-shift @eng-sre for monitoring. I'll remain reachable. Next actions for handoff: 1) watch error rate for 15m 2) confirm scaled proxies healthy 3) plan full config rollout if stable.
eng-sre: acknowledged. We'll continue to monitor and escalate to networking if error rate climbs back above 5%.
meera: follow-up: saved diagnostic bundle and uploaded to /internal/incidents/2105012345/logbundle.tar.gz. Contains tcpdump, nginx logs, kernel netstat at spike.
alex: closing loop: root cause likely connection pool exhaustion at edge -> transient upstream timeouts. Mitigations: short-term rate limiting, keepalive tuning, scale-up. Postmortem to follow with metrics and perf runbook updates.
incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated (degraded) — monitoring. Incident owners: eng-sre, meera. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2105012345
